key.name: black-hole
key.summary: Black hole: a window flung into a screen corner is swallowed (closed)

key.name: echo
key.summary: Echo windows: closed windows leave a fading after-image with a Reopen button

key.name: supernova
key.summary: Supernova: urgent notifications burst across the screen as a shockwave

key.name: wormhole
key.summary: Wormhole: switching workspace flies through a star tunnel

key.name: breathe
key.summary: Breathing desktop: the wallpaper slowly breathes (slower during focus / bedtime)

key.name: shatter-lock
key.summary: Shatter lock: locking cracks the desktop like glass, unlocking reassembles it

key.name: aurora
key.summary: Aurora: night-sky wallpaper that shows CPU load, notifications and downloads

key.name: living
key.summary: Living OS: dock glow / dust by use and a garden that grows on the wallpaper

key.name: smooth-guard
key.summary: Smooth Guard: when the shell stutters or the battery is low, pause the eye-candy until it's calm

key.name: dilation-key
key.summary: Time dilation: hold to slow time

key.name: planet-key
key.summary: Gravity well: make the focused window a planet (again to release)
